'''''Lotus lancerottensis''''' or '''Lanzarote heartworm''' is a species of plant in the ''[[Lotus (genus)|Lotus]]'' genus native to southern [[Madeira]] and the [[Canary Islands]] ([[Lanzarote]] and [[Fuerteventura]]).<ref name=Kew>{{Cite web |title=Lotus lancerottensis Webb & Berthel. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:503717-1 |access-date=2024-08-18 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Lotus lancerottensis Webb & Berthel. |url=https://endemicascanarias.com/es/allcategories-es-es/endemicas-compartidas/f-l/lotus-lancerottensis}}</ref>

== Description ==
This species is identified by its dark green leaves and puffed out yellow pea-like flowers. The leaves have fine spaced out whitish hairs.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lotus lancerottensis |url=https://www.freenatureimages.eu/plants/Flora%20J-N/Lotus%20lancerottensis/index.html#Lotus%2520lancerottensis%25201%252C%2520Saxifraga-Rutger%2520Barendse.JPG |access-date=2024-08-18 |website=www.freenatureimages.eu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Taxon - Legume Data Portal |url=https://www.legumedata.org/taxonomy/taxon/2346216 |access-date=2024-08-18 |website=www.legumedata.org}}</ref>

== Conservation status ==
This species is classified as Threatened by the Kew database.<ref name=Kew/>

== Symbiosis ==
This species is in symbiosis with a fungus called '''''[[Phyllobacterium salinisoli]]''''' that helps the roots more efficiently process fatty acids''.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=León-Barrios |first1=Milagros |last2=Ramírez-Bahena |first2=Martha Helena |last3=Igual |first3=José M. |last4=Peix |first4=Álvaro |last5=Velázquez |first5=Encarna |date=2018 |title=Phyllobacterium salinisoli sp. nov., isolated from a Lotus lancerottensis root nodule in saline soil from Lanzarote |url=https://www.microbiologyresearch.org/content/journal/ijsem/10.1099/ijsem.0.002628 |journal=International Journal of Systematic and Evolutionary Microbiology |volume=68 |issue=4 |pages=1085–1089 |doi=10.1099/ijsem.0.002628 |pmid=29458536 |issn=1466-5034|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
